Proof

\sketch The strong-neck coordinate gives distance at most $1.1\widetilde Q^{-1/2}\epsilon ^{-1}$ from the backward point to the cap point, and the cap-ball bound gives distance at most $A_0+5$ from that point to the cap tip. The curvature comparison

\begin{equation} (5D)^{-1}\leq \widetilde Q\leq 5D \end{equation}

and the chosen radius $A$ put the backward point inside the standard-flow ball.

□
